summary: RptDestProfileSummary is a user control in the HSPnet application for generating report profiles of destinations accessible to a user. It manages the workflow for running a report about destination profiles, handling validation, error messaging, and system behaviors based on user session context and input.
purpose: To allow authorized users to generate a profile summary report for selected destinations, with various error handling and access control checks.

workflows.name: Generate Destination Profile Summary Report
steps: Check if user is in 'SwitchUserViewOnly' mode; if so, hide 'Run Report' button.
On click of 'cmdRunReport', retrieve list of accessible destinations for user.
If no destinations are accessible, display error message with support contact.
If destination count exceeds system max, display error message with support contact.
Otherwise, concatenate destination codes and trigger PrintJobs.ReportDestinationProfileCreateJob for actual report creation.

business_rules: User cannot run reports when monitoring another user in 'SwitchUserViewOnly' mode.
User must have at least one accessible destination to run the report.
Report cannot be run if the number of destinations exceeds PrintJobs.MAX_INCLUDE_ITEMS.
validations: Destination access list must not be empty.
Destination count must be less than PrintJobs.MAX_INCLUDE_ITEMS.
calculations: Concatenation of DestinationCodeID values into a string separated by commas.
conditions: UserSession.SwitchUserViewOnly is true (monitoring a user): hide report button.
destList.Count > 0 and less than max: proceed with report creation.
system_behavior: Error messages are shown with support email links if validations fail.
Report creation job is triggered by PrintJobs.ReportDestinationProfileCreateJob when validations pass.
Button visibility dynamically changes based on user session context.
exceptions: Attempting to run report with no destinations available.
Attempting to run report with too many destinations.
